graph.description: The public-domain sources of the methanol-synthesis graph (CO and CO2 hydrogenation to methanol, literature published before 1966): 55 sources, 16 articles of 1923-1930 and 39 patents of 1925-1960 (38 US, 1 Polish), public domain in the United States (works published before 1931, US patents; the Polish patent as an official document). Their records are those of the full graph (graphs/methanol-synthesis-pre1966), with every quote in full, and the PDFs and page texts are in the folder, so every quote can be checked against its source. Shared records (species, reactions, people, institutions) keep only the evidence of these sources.

stewardship.note: The public-domain part of the methanol-synthesis graph, built from its parts (parts/); quotes in full, PDFs and page texts included.

graph.title: Methanol Synthesis, Public Domain
